prompts.front:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Create ONE transparent 3x3 disassembled sprite sheet for native 2D skeletal animation. Image 1 is the actual NEW rabbit frame in the REQUIRED view, the character identity and projection reference. Image 2 is the user's APPROVED COMPLETE-PARTS sheet, for component completeness and visual style only; its orientation must not override image 1. Match the same cream rabbit, chunky black outlines, tan apron/straps/pocket, brown tuft, peach cheeks, simple dot eyes and tiny mouth. Exactly nine separate COMPLETE closed-contour pieces, including normally occluded joint regions; never cut body along horizontal image lines or leave holes. Fill the torso fully underneath arms, complete the skull underneath ears. Same source character proportions: very large compact head, tiny body, short arms and feet. Genuine transparent background, ample space, no text, labels, grid, shadows, backdrop, assembled rabbit or extra objects.
3x3 row-major layout: (1) complete HEAD with facial features but NO ears/neck; (2) far ear complete with rounded root; (3) near ear complete with rounded root; (4) complete TORSO with apron/straps but NO arms/feet/head/tail; (5) far arm with complete shoulder and paw; (6) near arm with complete shoulder and paw; (7) far foot including short hidden ankle; (8) near foot including short hidden ankle; (9) complete round tan tail. Ears stand tall. Both arm parts separate from the torso; do not leave arm-shaped black/U lines or stubs on torso. Keep the approved sheet's simple warm palette and thick clean black outline. Each part fully inside its own cell and never touching another part.
REQUIRED VIEW: straight FRONT, face looking at viewer. Symmetrical open dot eyes, tiny smiling mouth, two peach cheeks, brown tuft centered above forehead. Both ears show tan inner patches. Apron front bib and pocket, no X straps on front. Front-facing tiny feet. Front-view complete pieces.

Exactly nine separate fully reconstructed closed-contour components, complete hidden joint areas. Skull closed beneath ears; torso complete beneath arms. NO mouth or forehead tuft. Ears seen from back, cream rear surfaces, NO pink/tan inner-ear patches. Torso rear three-quarter with crossed X apron straps and waist strap; NO front pocket/bib.
